correctness.rationale: For H_w=sum_j w_j X_j, commuting bit flips factor the entire walk into tensor products. Walsh characters simultaneously diagonalize the transition-probability matrix M(t) with eigenvalues lambda_S(t)=prod_{j in S}cos(2w_jt). Cesaro-averaging the exponential expansion yields mu_S=2^(-|S|)*#{eps in {-1,+1}^S:sum eps_j w_j=0}, nonnegative, with mu_empty=1. Uniform average is equivalent to all nonempty mu_S=0, equivalent by cancellation to distinct subset sums. For positive integer weights, zero singleton integrals force 2w_jT/pi in Z, hence T=k*pi/(2g) by Bezout, and at such T every nonzero signed integer frequency integrates to zero. Distinct integer subset sums count 2^d different integers between 0 and sum w_j, proving budget >=2^d-1. Equality forces binary weights uniquely by product_j(1+z^{w_j})=sum_{a=0}^{2^d-1} z^a and iterative even-degree factorization. Instantaneous uniformity iff each cos(2w_jt)=0, equivalent to identical 2-adic valuations. Independent exact fractional calculations compared Walsh and energy-projector time averages over 209 weighted profiles in d=1..4 and checked unique positive integer budget minimizers through d=4.
